1000:2d1f.name: RenderRoadSceneSpans
1000:2d1f.plate_comment: Draw the original VGA road scene using eight TREKDAT span banks selected by forward/8192 modulo 8. Rows are drawn far to near, columns 0,1,2,3 then mirrored 6,5,4,3; special tables 528/576 insert the ship between tunnel layers. Ground/top nibbles, six structure kinds and 74 logical color pairs control facets. Native scene allocation is 320x138 bytes. JS full redraw matches 287 captured native indexed scenes across all roads; native incremental caching is replaced. See analysis/skyroads/GRAPHICS-CHECKPOINT.md.

1000:0c98.name: RenderShipAndRoadScene
1000:0c98.plate_comment: Select ship lane, pose, animation/explosion offset and shadow height, then call VGA span renderer 2d1f. Ship atlas frame stride 720; column-major 29x24 visible pixels. VGA camera uses the original fixed projection, not ship-following camera offsets. Eight original arguments observed in running DOSBox; graphics-validation.json checks derived values and indexed scene bytes. EGA path is not ported.

1000:0baf.name: SelectShipVerticalPose
1000:0baf.plate_comment: Select one of three ship poses using tunnel context and signed vertical speed thresholds -354/355 plus height 10240. Pose within seven lane views contributes to the 63 normal ship frames. Raw instruction-derived model is exercised in native renderer comparisons.

1000:0be9.name: SelectShipLaneView
1000:0be9.plate_comment: Compute original ship view index from lateral/128: signed (value-95)/46, clamped 0..6. This lane selects static horizontal offsets and sprite groups; it does not move the world camera. Verified renderer argument comparisons in graphics-validation.json.

1000:3f91.name: ReadPictureColorPalette
1000:3f91.plate_comment: Read CMAP resource header: ASCII CMAP, byte color count, count*3 VGA RGB6 bytes and count*2 EGA mapping bytes. Original palettes compose road 0..71, car 72..91, dashboard 92..141, world 142..255. Each extracted palette matches native RAM over all 30 menu roads and demo.

1000:4084.name: DecodeResourcePictureBlock
1000:4084.plate_comment: Read PICT block: signature plus uint16 destination offset, height, width, followed by shared LZS stream. Nonzero indexed pixels are palette-offset for VGA; zero remains transparent. Exact LZS consumption determines the next block. Extracted car/background bytes match running original RAM; see extract-skyroads-graphics.py.

1000:5387.name: LoadWorldBackgroundImage
1000:5387.plate_comment: Load selected WORLD0..9 CMAP/PICT background. Three playable roads share each world; demo uses WORLD0. World palette starts at index 142. Browser uses original decoded pixels and palette; all ten worlds checked against running original RAM.

1000:5567.name: LoadShipAndDashboardImages
1000:5567.plate_comment: Load CARS.LZS and DASHBRD.LZS CMAP/PICT data with VGA palette bases 72 and 92. Cars decode to 55440 bytes: 77 frames, stride720, 29x24 visible column-major pixels per frame. Dashboard nonzero pixels overlay world at destination offset41280. Native instrument updates remain outside new static dashboard port.
